# Get URL Component

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Retrieves component about URL.

## Syntax

~~~~text
urlComponent(url: <#String (Allows Variables)#>, component: <#Enumeration (WFURLComponent)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
urlComponent(url: "https://jellycuts.com", component: Scheme)
~~~~
